b1-08-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Planning the Journey
b1-08-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning a trip from Budapest to Madrid to see your grandmother. Meg asks what you are going to do first. You are going to prepare the itinerary tonight and look for accommodation.
b1-08-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you are going to do tonight and what you are going to look for.
cues: Say what you are going to prepare tonight
Say what you are going to look for
b1-08-01.target: Voy a preparar el itinerario esta noche y vamos a buscar un alojamiento.
b1-08-01.english: I am going to prepare the itinerary tonight and we are going to look for accommodation.
b1-08-01.canDo: I can explain a travel plan using future and intention structures.

b1-08-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Something Went Wrong
b1-08-02.scenario: You are Meg. You have just come back from Madrid and Carlos asks what happened at the station. When you arrived there were a lot of people, and the train left late because there was a breakdown.
b1-08-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the station was like when you arrived and why the train was late.
cues: Say what there was at the station
Say why the train left late
b1-08-02.target: Cuando llegamos a la estación, había mucha gente. El tren salió con retraso porque había una avería.
b1-08-02.english: When we arrived at the station, there were a lot of people. The train left late because there was a breakdown.
b1-08-02.canDo: I can narrate a travel problem using the main past tenses.

b1-08-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting Around Madrid
b1-08-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how you moved around Madrid on your first day. You travelled from the hotel to the station on foot and walked through the old town.
b1-08-03.prompt: Tell Meg where you travelled from and to, and where you walked.
cues: Say where you travelled from and to
b1-08-03.target: Nos desplazamos desde el hotel hasta la estación y caminamos por el casco antiguo.
b1-08-03.english: We travelled from the hotel to the station and walked through the old town.
b1-08-03.canDo: I can describe movement through and between places.

b1-08-04.title: Communicative Challenge: If We Miss the Train
b1-08-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you will do if you miss the train in Madrid. You will look for an alternative and tell the accommodation.
b1-08-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what you will do if you miss the train.
b1-08-04.target: Si perdemos el tren, buscaremos una alternativa y avisaremos al alojamiento.
b1-08-04.english: If we miss the train, we will look for an alternative and notify the accommodation.
b1-08-04.canDo: I can discuss realistic travel contingencies.

b1-08-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Journey of Odiseo
b1-08-05.scenario: You are Meg. You have just read the story of Odiseo and Carlos asks what happens in it. A storm changes the course of his ships, he loses his ships and his men, and in the end he reaches Ítaca, where Penélope is waiting for him.
b1-08-05.prompt: Retell the story of Odiseo to Carlos in two sentences.
b1-08-05.target: Una tormenta cambia el rumbo de Odiseo y él pierde sus barcos. Al final llega a Ítaca, donde Penélope lo espera.
b1-08-05.english: A storm changes Odiseo's course and he loses his ships. In the end he reaches Ítaca, where Penélope is waiting for him.
b1-08-05.canDo: I can communicate about a journey using connected travel language.

b1-08-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Trip Plans and Problems
b1-08-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about the trip to Madrid. You are going to travel by train, and if you miss the connection you will look for an alternative.
b1-08-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg your travel plan and what you will do if there is a problem.
cues: Say how you are going to travel
Say what you will do if you miss the connection
b1-08-consolidation.target: Vamos a viajar en tren. Si perdemos la conexión, buscaremos una alternativa.
b1-08-consolidation.english: We are going to travel by train. If we miss the connection, we will look for an alternative.
b1-08-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about travel plans, problems, routes and possible changes.
